the evaluation of interactive machine-learning systems is challenging.
the evaluation of interactive machine systems should include both algorithm-centered analysis and human-centered evaluation.

“Human-centered evaluation is an essential component in the validation of interactive machine learning, and can play a key role in the design of future systems that learn from and adapt for the human user”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation, and evaluation of interactive machine-learning systems.
the design, evaluation, and analysis of interactive machine learning applications, with the goal of improving the user experience, and the performance and utility of these systems.
the development of a new research agenda, which combines the strengths of machine learning, human-centered design and visual analytics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we need more work in order to understand how interactive machine learning systems work, and how they can be used effectively.
we still need more work in this area.
the evaluation of interactive machine systems is a complex task, which requires a combination of different methods and techniques.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
human-centered design is a crucial component in the design and evaluation of interactive machine-learning systems.
human-centered evaluation and algorithm-centered analysis can be used in a symbiotic way for the design and evaluation of interactive machine systems.
the human plays an active role in machine learning and the machine learning process is not just about algorithms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
interactive machine learning applications are complex systems that require both algorithmic analysis and human-centered evaluation.
human-centered design is a key component of interactive machine learning, and that human factors should not be neglected in the design of such systems.
human-centered evaluation is essential to understand the complex interplay between the system and human in the context of interactive machine learning.
